rows.title: Skip repeated canonicalization when private publication state is already canonical

specification.title: Skip repeated canonicalization when private publication state is already canonical
specification.scope: Private publication replay with an authenticated canonical seed and dirty flag; n completed Def updates followed by n ADT updates. Does not replace checking or carry the flag across checker mutations.
specification.whatWorkDisappears: Whole-book reverse, name validation, duplicate selection and reconstruction before each consecutive non-childless publication after the first clean boundary.
specification.charged: Fixture construction, original declaration installation, all index updates, dirty-state records, first required canonicalization, unconditional original final canonicalization, full all-field string observation and ordinary cleanup.
specification.admission: The clean bit is established privately by check_declarations and reset only after canonicalization plus book_put. No arbitrary caller may assert it. Internal checker mutation integration remains unaudited.
specification.negativeControls: Every prefix of mixed replacements, childful Def, Foreign, empty names and full-hash collision names is independently finalized. ADTs are never blindly logged.

specification.title: Batch initial declaration installation with the existing exact overlay helper
specification.scope: Initial declaration installation only, before checking: n independent ADTs and n Def declarations over a disjoint Base-shaped seed. No dependent check or successful-body publication is reordered.
specification.whatWorkDisappears: Repeated per-definition outer book insertion/filter transport, replaced by one existing immutable overlay; index_set order is preserved.
specification.charged: Mapping every event through unchanged Foreign/declared choice, retained existing book_put_many admission scans/fallback, complete output observation and cleanup.
specification.priorNegative: Fresh-name cached insertion already avoids index_remove through index_put_rest, so this may add work. Independent successful-definition batching is not justified merely by distinct names: p155p_deferred_type is the concrete counterexample to a broader rule.

specification.title: Reuse constructor membership metadata across append-only successful declaration history
specification.scope: Constructor-name validation component over n unique ADT owner events. Odd n appends a duplicate constructor event and returns the exact successful prefix world plus unchanged first error. This is not full type or dependent checking.
specification.whatWorkDisappears: Repeated whole-event-history constructor_exists scans for each newly declared constructor, replaced by full-name collision-correct indexed membership.
specification.charged: Start with an empty index, insert every successful constructor, retain original local-duplicate list checks and book publication, observe every final world field plus full error, and destroy the auxiliary index.
specification.admission: Unique owner names and successful append-only history; arbitrary replacement/removal and cache-record events require a separate fallback. Do not attach this index to the mutable checker world.
specification.negativeControls: Within-row duplicates, cross-owner duplicates, empty constructor names, and costarring/liquid full-hash collision. Replaced ADT counterexample explicitly prevents stale cache generalization.

specification.conversionAndCleanup: Fresh inputs/cache/intermediate data/output for each repetition; complete String returned and consumed by caller. No length-only or prefix-only acceptance. Whole child includes teardown.

specification.title: Fuse UTF-8 name-table traversal and QBE rendering
specification.scope: All 185 compiler and 150 Map constructor names, in exact captured order, rendered as the p111_cid_names_N string-data declarations. Old: current p111q_utf8 plus p111q_data. New: direct character-to-QBE byte text. Each n repeats both complete tables.
specification.whatWorkDisappears: Per-byte P111QByte objects, the UTF-8 reversed list/reversal, datum-to-String list construction and later fragment flattening. Decimal formatting and full final String remain.
specification.oracle: Exact canonical old/new String equality for every control; additional literal UTF-8 controls include empty, ASCII, 2/3/4-byte Unicode, embedded NUL/newline.
limitations: These are complete string-data definitions, not a whole backend or bounded native publication cursor.
Active P134 streaming also caps datum slices; this pure one-string screen does not establish peak-memory parity for long data rows.
The original table-building path materializes UTF-8 before later emission; moving construction changes lifetime and requires a future full native-request test.
n repetitions concatenate both distinct workloads; this output is a benchmark text corpus, not one linkable QBE program.

rows.title: Replace the eager token list with a one-way fused lexer/parser cursor

specification.title: Replace the eager token list with a one-way fused lexer/parser cursor
specification.reason: The actual parser requires repeatable lookahead, rewind with a newer context, synthetic-token pushback, and exact original-token checkpoint identity. A one-way consuming cursor violates those interfaces; a persistent cursor without memoization may rescan source. No bounded replacement preserving these contracts is provided, so this row must not be performance-tested or scored as a measured loss.
specification.scope: Reject the proposed local one-way substitution, not all possible future lexer/parser fusion designs.
specification.whatWorkDisappears: Intended token-list/FInput construction and reversal; currently coupled to persistent parser positions and checkpoint identity.
specification.limitations: Source audit only. No target run, native counterexample execution, throughput number or impossibility theorem. A redesigned memoized/token-buffer parser remains separate work.
specification.counterexampleMeaning: f_grow_existing explicitly admits an operator after a newline into the preceding expression. Flushing a fused parse unit at each newline would lose this behavior. Independently, f_context_rewind(old,new) must recover old tokens while retaining new context.

rows.title: Fuse identifier syntax and exact reserved-word classification into one scalar scan

specification.title: Fuse identifier syntax and exact reserved-word classification into one scalar scan
specification.scope: Actual maintained Phase150 scalar lexer plus complete maintained name-validation consumer, applied to every token of fresh valid Bend source per repetition. This is not the complete grammar parser, loader, checker or a whole-compiler request.
specification.whatWorkDisappears: Repeated first/tail projections and dot lookahead in f_name_chars, plus up to16 sequential String equality calls in f_reserved. Candidate validates identifier segments and accumulates exact first-six ASCII bytes in two U32 lanes during one scan; capped length and exact byte keys preserve keyword case and avoid hash collision assumptions.
specification.observedOutput: U32 tagged rolling observation returned as decimal String; consumes complete token text, all six scalar FToken fields and every predicate result. The checksum is a timing observer, not an equality proof;42 independent exact Boolean controls constrain the rule.
specification.chargedWork: Fresh source construction with varying numeric literal, the unchanged real lexer, complete token/name observation, recursive repeat and result destruction under the root's whole-process clock. No prelexed input or interning cache.
specification.limitations: No native timing or check has run for this source yet. Finite lexical/name controls do not qualify the full parse consumer. Some callers already test f_reserved before f_valid_name, so replacing only this predicate does not remove all duplicate classification. ASCII syntax is intentional and matches the existing predicate; Unicode remains rejected as a name. A full parser comparison and normal qualification would still be required before integration.
specification.promotionGate: Reject on any control/old-new mismatch. Even a large local gain needs measured transfer through the complete parser, because Phase150 already reduced lexical work and remaining parse costs are distributed. Never multiply this proxy ratio by the whole parse stage.
